purpose: Defines the principle that deterministic artifacts are produced by a deterministic executor rather than AI, what checks become unnecessary, and where validation belongs.

sections.heading: 決定論的な生成物は AI が作らない
6.1 AI の応答そのものを構造化データとして受け取る場合

summary: Purpose: break the chain where AI-built artifacts require checks that silently drop items
Principle: deterministic executor builds the artifact; AI only decides content
Rationale chain: AI builds, errors possible, checks needed, allowlist, silent drops
What becomes unnecessary: runtime format checks, duplicate schemas, path mix-ups, intermediate files
Scope: structured data, file paths and names, writes, ID numbering, enumeration and aggregation
Non-applicable areas: natural language interpretation, flow control, dialogue, content decisions
Exception: validating an AI response received as structured data at a single boundary
Validation placement: on the producer side, one check point per data
Severity catalog of violation patterns with critical and major levels
tasks: Designing a skill or agent that passes data to scripts
Reviewing code or documents for AI-built structured output
Deciding whether to move file writing or ID numbering into a script
Assigning review severity for deterministic generation violations
title: 決定論的な生成物は AI が作らない
